checks.describe: the platformops v0.0 checkpoint has pyproject, lock, src, tests, README, .gitignore and .python-version
checks.run: ls labs/platformops/pyproject.toml labs/platformops/uv.lock labs/platformops/src/platformops/__init__.py labs/platformops/tests/test_foundation.py labs/platformops/README.md labs/platformops/.gitignore labs/platformops/.python-version

checks.describe: the checkpoint does not ship a committed .venv (rebuilt from uv.lock instead)
checks.run: test -d labs/platformops/.venv && echo PRESENT || echo ABSENT

checks.describe: src/platformops/__init__.py carries the v0.0.0 version string
pyproject.toml's own version matches the v0.0 release
ruff check passes inside the checkpoint (the first quality gate)
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run ruff check . 2>&1

checks.describe: ruff format has nothing left to rewrite in the checkpoint
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run ruff format --check . 2>&1

checks.describe: pytest passes inside the checkpoint (the second quality gate)
about() returns a string naming the toolkit and the current version
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run python -c "from platformops import about; print(about())"
